newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Germany's DBBH extends offer for Hungary bank shrs.
newsitem.headline: Germany's DBBH extends offer for Hungary bank shrs.

text.p: Germany's Deutsche Balaton Broker Holding AG (DBBH) on Friday extended until May 30 its public offer for the series "C" preference shares of Hungarian bank Magyar Kulkereskedelmi Bank Rt.

DBBH, which released its statement via its wholly owned Hungarian broker subsidiary, Elso Magyarorszagi Nemet Ertekpapirkereskedelmi Kft, gave no reason for the move but said it left conditions unchanged.

DBBH's original offer, made at 35,000 forint per share for MKB stocks, expires on Friday. Earlier it also said that if shares were delivered without dividend coupon, the offer prices would be reduced by 1,950 forints.
MKB is majority owned by Germany's Bayerische Landesbank Girozentrale.
